Class BaseTUIController

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am56.view.TUI.controllers.BaseTUIController
All Implemented Interfaces:
UpdateHandler, MessageVisitor
Direct Known Subclasses:
GameController, LobbyController, NetworkSetupController, PreLobbyController
public abstract class BaseTUIController extends Object implements UpdateHandler, MessageVisitor
Base class for every TUI screen. Each screen is both an UpdateHandler (so the active screen receives server messages, errors and disconnections from the connection) and a MessageVisitor (so those messages are dispatched to a typed visit method via double dispatch). Subclasses implement onEnter() to render and drive their screen, and override the visit methods for the message types they care about.

It provides shared access to the TUIContext and its drawer/input reader, plus default handling for errors (printed) and disconnections (print and exit).
